kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Band Rs 181-191, lot 78 (company announcement, 23-Nov-2026; RHP prints [●]). Shares were issued at Rs 363 in FY25-26 (p. 329). At Rs 191: 6.24 crore post-offer shares, market cap Rs 1,191 cr; P/E 40.9x FY26 PAT (about 55x at a 25.17% tax rate); company's own P/E 34.2x basic / 34.9x diluted; P/B 2.9x post-offer; EV/EBITDA 19.2x FY26 EBITDA after lease rentals.

focus.title: Current vs deferred tax
focus.detail: Effective tax near nil: FY26 tax Rs -0.11 cr on PBT Rs 29.00 cr (current Rs 1.26 cr, deferred credit Rs 1.37 cr) as earlier losses are absorbed. At a normal 25.17% rate FY26 PAT would be about Rs 21.7 cr, so reported P/E flatters by about a third.

focus.title: Contingent liabilities
focus.detail: Income Tax search and seizure under s.132 on 17-21 Dec-2025 (Rs 1.06 cr cash seized); notice under s.158BC for the block period Apr-2019 to Feb-2026; no order yet; the auditor highlights it as an emphasis of matter. GST show-cause for Rs 23.32 cr, of which Rs 0.41 cr tax plus interest and penalty was confirmed and is under appeal. Contingent liabilities Rs 4.51 cr (Sep-26).

focus.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
focus.detail: MSKA & Associates LLP (auditor since Nov-2023): unmodified opinion with emphasis of matter on the Income Tax search and its possible financial implications.

focus.title: SME conditions
focus.detail: Issue made under Reg 6(2) (the company does not meet the profitability track-record test): at least 75% to QIBs, at most 15% to NIIs and at most 10% to retail.

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess

focus.title: Data gap (high)
focus.detail: Outcome of the Income Tax block assessment (s.158BC)

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Segment profitability (events vs restaurants vs banquets)

comfort.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
comfort.detail: FY26 basic EPS Rs 5.58 on PAT Rs 29.11 cr = 5.22 crore weighted shares, in line with the 5,22,98,600 pre-offer shares (bonus 5:1 in Feb-2025 already reflected). Diluted EPS Rs 5.48 includes 16.05 lakh ESOPs in force at Rs 149.34 (p. 148).

comfort.title: Cash flow vs profit
comfort.detail: CFO Rs 23.35 / 43.99 / 29.91 cr FY24-26 against PAT Rs -15.35 / 14.26 / 29.11 cr: cumulative CFO Rs 97.25 cr vs PAT Rs 28.02 cr. But CFO is before lease payments of Rs 20.28 / 23.21 / 25.87 cr (shown in financing); after leases cumulative cash from operations is Rs 27.9 cr. H1 FY27 CFO Rs 44.16 cr despite a Rs 16.15 cr loss (receivables collected).

comfort.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
comfort.detail: Related-party transactions Rs 6.11 / 9.33 / 9.25 cr FY24-26 (1.6-2.1% of revenue), mostly managerial remuneration and sitting fees; promoter remuneration Rs 2.89 cr in FY26 paid via the UAE subsidiary.

comfort.title: Goodwill vs tangible equity
comfort.detail: No goodwill; other intangibles Rs 1.43 cr. Right-of-use assets Rs 89.14 cr against lease liabilities Rs 103.68 cr (Mar-26).

comfort.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
comfort.detail: No customer concentration disclosed as a risk: events business serves many one-off hosts (1,092 events in FY26). Top 10 suppliers 19.28% of materials in FY26. Events catering is 52.89% of FY26 revenue and highly seasonal (H2 = 63-70% of revenue, p. 50).

comfort.title: Monitoring agency
comfort.detail: Fresh issue above Rs 100 cr: monitoring agency required and appointed.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported P/E is a fair measure: the adjustments found move FY26 PAT by +1.4%, within the 10% threshold. On the FY24-FY26 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 130.8x reported and 137.1x adjusted.
